title: Crop-Event Restart Boundary and Accepted-Window Lifecycle Retirement Qualification
source_bound_restart_findings: F-WOF38 makes crop owner plus accepted-event receipt one committed F-KT physical state, so no separate crop receipt persistence owner is required.
kernel_committed_state_t keeps physical state, lineage id, revision and committed time private.
kernel_committed_state_t exposes clone, snapshot and checkpoint capture but no restore/import API for an already-advanced committed revision.
kernel_committed_state_t initialize always creates revision zero and therefore cannot reconstruct an arbitrary persisted committed revision without changing the F-KT contract.
F-MR18 explicitly left restart/crash atomicity unqualified.
A WOFOST-specific serializer must not forge or bypass private F-KT lineage/revision/time provenance.

minimum_generic_restore_requirement: validate provenance without allowing arbitrary revision forgery
preserve checkpoint and candidate stale-revision protection after restore

accepted_window_restart_state_if_generic.legacy_event_delivered: not an atomic-route authority; may remain a derived lifecycle cache only

lifecycle_problem.current_atomic_route: after successful F-WOF38 crop commit the committed crop receipt prevents duplicate crop advancement, but the source accepted window can still report event_due because the legacy event_delivered bit was deliberately not used as a second commit authority
lifecycle_problem.risk: a runtime that incorrectly treats event_due as authoritative could repeatedly attempt an already-consumed event; F-WOF38 rejects the duplicate, but the stale window should be retired cleanly
lifecycle_problem.required_semantics: retirement must be derived from an already-committed matching crop receipt, must never authorize crop publication, and must be safe to repeat or replay after interruption

selected_lifecycle_design.operation: reconcile a complete accepted window against an already-committed fmr_wofost_crop_transaction_state_t receipt
selected_lifecycle_design.after_matching_receipt: mark only the legacy delivered/cache bit through the existing validated token path
selected_lifecycle_design.already_retired_result: terminal nonmutating lifecycle state; it is not independent proof that the atomic receipt route was used

qualification_gates.A_restart_boundary: source-bound fail-closed proof that true crash restart is blocked by generic F-KT persistence, not by missing WOFOST crop owner state
qualification_gates.B_precommit_noninterference: a complete window cannot retire before a matching committed crop receipt exists
qualification_gates.C_postcommit_retirement: matching committed receipt retires the stale accepted window without changing crop owner, receipt or F-KT revision
qualification_gates.D_duplicate_and_replay: after retirement event_due is false; repeated reconciliation is nonmutating
qualification_gates.E_preservation: F-WOF38 main atomic gate and Gate E failed-then-accepted retry remain green
qualification_gates.F_optimization_identity: O0 and O2 outputs identical for lifecycle gate
